description_en: Queries a list of recording template configurations by calling the DescribeRecordTemplates operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeRecordTemplates查询录制模板配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-record-templates --template-ids example-string --app-id yourAppId --page-size 10 --page-num 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecordTemplates

parameters.help_en:
The list of template IDs to query. The format is as follows:

```
TemplateIds.1=****
TemplateIds.2=****
......
```

To obtain a template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193625.html
parameters.help_zh:
查询模板ID列表，格式如下所示：

```
TemplateIds.1=****
TemplateIds.2=****
......
```

获取模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193625.html
parameters.name: template_ids

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the application ID in the console. Only a single ID can be passed
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，默认取值**10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. By default, the first page (**1**) is queried
parameters.name: page_num
